replacement: state the two facts plainly

replacement: end the sentence; give the cause as its own fact
why: A trailing 'which highlights / reflects' clause fakes analysis, the Arabic twin of the English -ing rider.

replacement: active verb with a named or generic subject

good_example: نوصل طلبك خلال ساعتين

replacement: one digit system per piece (codes and URLs excepted)

good_example: خصم ٢٠٪ على الطلبات فوق ١٥٠ ريال

replacement: هـ + verb (هتوصلك، هنفتح)

good_example: الهدية هتوصلك مع أول طلب

good_example: التوصيل مش مجاني برة القاهرة

why: Announcing importance instead of showing it.

replacement: state the claim flat

why: של for every noun pair mirrors English 'of'; three in one sentence is the tell.

why: LLM Hebrew defaults to masculine forms; a plural or neutral CTA avoids the gender error, as copy.md already does for Arabic.

good_example: Tüm ürünlerde %30 indirim

replacement: Drop the comma after the connective ending
